text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking be introduced on Homeview Avenue from Jane Street to Florence Crescent, 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Homeview Avenue from Jane Street to Florence Crescent, to accommodate their long-term parking needs.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking by permit only to be in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the even (north) side of Homeview Avenue from Jane Street to Florence Crescent.
